description: This Java class 'DirectorySearch' provides utility methods for locating directories within a project, such as repository root, module root, source directories, exclude directories, and template directories. It includes methods for traversing directory structures, pattern matching for exclusions, and caching directory paths.

classes.name: DirectorySearch
classes.description: Utility class for directory location and traversal within a project.

methods.name: getRepoRoot
methods.description: Returns the previously initialized repository root directory.

methods.name: findAndInitRepoRoot
methods.description: Recursively finds and sets the repository root directory based on presence of '.repo' directory.

methods.name: findModuleRoot
methods.description: Finds the parent directory containing 'Android.mk', indicating a module root.

methods.name: findSourceDirs
methods.description: Recursively searches for source directories like 'src' or 'java' from a starting point.

methods.name: findExcludeDirs
methods.description: Finds directories under 'res' matching pattern 'values-..(-.*)*', typically for language exclusions.

methods.name: findTemplateDir
methods.description: Locates the template directory, with caching and support for different execution environments.
